finding.headline: "The 'Is My Baby Even Getting Enough?' Screener"
finding.problem: "I stare at his tiny face after a feed and I don't know if he's full or starving. Everyone says 'trust your body' but my body feels like it's failing him."
finding.recurring_situation: EMOTIONAL (feeling like BF is failing · pressure · guilt · exhaustion)
finding.person: A 30-yr-old Lagos mum, 3 weeks PP, baby fusses after feeds, she pumps 20ml and panics; obsessed with wet-nappy counts and "is my milk disappearing?"
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone / Marketing angle — "Enough? The No-Panic Milk-Supply Reality Check (Wet Nappies, Weight, Behaviour)."". Verdict: PASSES (22/25)..
